🔄 Content updated (published: July 30, 2026)

We are accepting donations for the 2026 Kumamoto Earthquake Disaster Relief Fund.

Donation boxes are set up at the information counter on the 1st floor of Hanno City Hall Main Building. We accept donations on weekdays from 9:00 AM to 4:30 PM, from July 31, 2026 (Friday) to October 23, 2026 (Friday). If you need a receipt, visit the Community Welfare Division (Window 11) on the 1st floor of City Hall.

All donations are forwarded through the Japanese Red Cross to the disaster relief fund distribution committees of affected prefectures, and 100% of donations go to disaster victims.

【Direct Bank Transfer (if you prefer not to donate at City Hall)】

Japan Post Bank / Post Office
Account number: 00190-3-605956
Account holder name: Japanese Red Cross 2026 Kumamoto Earthquake Disaster Relief Fund
Transfer fee is waived at post office windows. If you want a receipt, write "Receipt requested" (受領証希望) in the communication section of the transfer slip and include your name, address, and phone number in the sender field. Receipts take about 3 months to issue.

Acceptance period: July 31, 2026 (Friday) – October 30, 2026 (Friday)

Bank Transfer
Sumitomo Mitsui Bank Suzuran Branch, Regular Account 2787553
Mitsubishi UFJ Bank Yamabiko Branch, Regular Account 2105551
Mizuho Bank Kunugi Branch, Regular Account 0620820
Account holder: Japanese Red Cross Society

Always verify the bank name and account number before transferring.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/kenkohukusibu/chiikifukushika/14121.html
